frontmatter.title: Command vs. query prompts: a CQRS-inspired framework for structuring LLM interactions

frontmatter.excerpt: Apply CQRS thinking to prompt engineering - learn how splitting command and query prompts improves LLM reliability, tracing, and eval coverage.
